chk_features_origin.name: chk_features_origin
chk_features_origin.value:
("content_feature_sets"."publication_id" is not null and "content_feature_sets"."external_example_id" is null)
        or ("content_feature_sets"."publication_id" is null and "content_feature_sets"."external_example_id" is not null)

chk_metrics_non_negative.name: chk_metrics_non_negative
chk_metrics_non_negative.value:
("metric_snapshots"."impressions" is null or "metric_snapshots"."impressions" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."reach" is null or "metric_snapshots"."reach" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."views" is null or "metric_snapshots"."views" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."likes" is null or "metric_snapshots"."likes" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."comments" is null or "metric_snapshots"."comments" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."shares" is null or "metric_snapshots"."shares" >= 0)
        and ("metric_snapshots"."saves" is null or "metric_snapshots"."saves" >= 0)

chk_messages_content.name: chk_messages_content
chk_messages_content.value: "messages"."content" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."content_json" IS NOT NULL

chk_news_scores.name: chk_news_scores
chk_news_scores.value:
("news_items"."relevance_score" is null or "news_items"."relevance_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."freshness_score" is null or "news_items"."freshness_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."authority_score" is null or "news_items"."authority_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."novelty_score" is null or "news_items"."novelty_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."project_match_score" is null or "news_items"."project_match_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."audience_match_score" is null or "news_items"."audience_match_score" between 0 and 100)
          and ("news_items"."final_score" is null or "news_items"."final_score" between 0 and 100)
